c-sep.vacuum.key: Lowering the pressure lowers the boiling point, so high-boiling or heat-sensitive compounds don't decompose

c-sep.acid-extract.key: Moves the acid into the water layer as its carboxylate salt

c-sep.ief.key: The pH equals its isoelectric point (net charge zero)

c-sep.recryst.key: Well when hot and poorly when cold

c-redox.conc-cell.key: E°cell = 0, but current flows until the concentrations become equal

b-signal.gq.key: PIP₂ is split into IP₃, which releases Ca²⁺ from the ER, and DAG, which activates protein kinase C

b-signal.rtk.key: Ligand binding brings receptor halves together and they phosphorylate each other's tyrosines

b-signal.amplify.key: Each step of the cascade activates many molecules of the next

b-signal.pde.key: It lasts longer, because cAMP is broken down more slowly

b-nerve.ipsp.key: Cl⁻ entering or K⁺ leaving the cell, making the membrane more negative

b-nerve.ache.key: Prolongs acetylcholine's action, so stimulation lasts longer

b-nerve.sympathetic.key: Pupils dilate and heart rate rises

b-nerve.reflex.key: The sensory neuron synapses directly on a motor neuron in the spinal cord

b-endo.thyroid-fb.key: High, because low thyroid hormone removes negative feedback

b-endo.cortisol.key: Raise blood glucose and suppress the immune response

b-endo.pth.key: Raises calcium: bone resorption, kidney reabsorption and vitamin D activation

b-endo.releasing.key: Through the hypophyseal portal blood vessels

b-circ.av.key: So the atria finish contracting and the ventricles fill before they contract

b-circ.lymph.key: Returns it to the blood near the heart

b-circ.type-o.key: They carry neither A nor B antigens

b-circ.fetal-hb.key: Binds O₂ more tightly, so it can take O₂ from the mother's blood

b-circ.s1.key: The AV valves closing as the ventricles start to contract

b-resp.inhale.key: The diaphragm contracts, chest volume rises and lung pressure falls below atmospheric

b-resp.surfactant.key: Lowers surface tension so alveoli don't collapse

b-resp.hypervent.key: Respiratory alkalosis, from blowing off CO₂

b-resp.co.key: It binds hemoglobin far more tightly than O₂ does, blocking O₂ transport

b-resp.diffusion.key: Simple diffusion down its partial-pressure gradient

b-digest.trypsin.key: Enteropeptidase on the small-intestine lining cleaves it to trypsin

b-digest.cck.key: Cholecystokinin (CCK), which contracts the gallbladder and stimulates pancreatic enzymes

b-digest.secretin.key: The pancreas to release bicarbonate-rich fluid

b-digest.chylomicron.key: Packaging into chylomicrons that enter the lacteals (lymph)

b-digest.glucagon.key: Stimulating glycogen breakdown and gluconeogenesis in the liver

b-immune.mhc2.key: MHC class II on antigen-presenting cells

b-immune.mhc1.key: A viral peptide on MHC class I

b-immune.antibody.key: The variable regions at the tips of the heavy and light chains

b-immune.secondary.key: Memory B and T cells specific to the antigen already exist

b-immune.clonal.key: An antigen activates the lymphocytes whose receptors already match it, and they multiply

b-immune.nk.key: Display too little MHC class I

b-muscle.troponin.key: Troponin, which moves tropomyosin off myosin-binding sites on actin

b-muscle.ttubule.key: Carry the action potential deep into the fiber to trigger Ca²⁺ release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum

b-muscle.smooth.key: Calmodulin, which activates myosin light-chain kinase

b-muscle.motor-unit.key: By recruiting more motor units and firing them faster

b-muscle.slow-twitch.key: Rich in mitochondria and myoglobin, and fatigue-resistant

b-muscle.calcitonin.key: Lower blood calcium by reducing bone resorption

b-repro.oogenesis.key: One egg and two or three polar bodies

b-repro.arrest.key: Metaphase II, completing meiosis only if fertilized

b-repro.corpus.key: Progesterone, which maintains the uterine lining

b-repro.polyspermy.key: The cortical reaction, which hardens the zona pellucida

b-repro.cleavage.key: Divides into more, smaller cells without growing overall

b-evo.fitness.key: Leaves the most surviving, fertile offspring

b-evo.homologous.key: Homologous structures, from a common ancestor

b-evo.kin.key: Kin selection: helping relatives passes on shared genes (inclusive fitness)

b-evo.unit.key: Populations: allele frequencies change across generations

p-heat.isothermal.key: ΔU = 0, so the heat absorbed equals the work done

p-heat.second-law.key: Heat flows spontaneously from hot to cold, never the reverse on its own

p-mag.no-work.key: Changes its direction but not its speed

p-atomic.intensity.key: Ejects more electrons but does not raise their maximum kinetic energy

p-atomic.absorption.key: The same wavelengths the gas emits when heated

p-atomic.fluorescence.key: Some energy is lost (as vibration/heat) before the photon is emitted

p-atomic.bohr.key: Electron energy levels are quantized, so only certain energy gaps exist
